messages:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: ALERT: smart-routing error spike detected for service=api.redwood.com model=redwood-xl-v2 - rolling fallbacks into eu-west with variant=redwood-xl-v2-quantized (unexpected). 5xx rate increased from 0.6% -> 12% over last 7m. Affected routes: /v1/generate (primary us-west -> fallback eu-west). Pager sent to #incidents and @sre_oncall.
Emma L: seeing the same on the dashboards — latency for fallback requests jumps and then 502s. Traces show mismatch in model handlers (quantized path) throwing kernel errors.
Raj P: paging @sre_oncall now. tagging platform/eng-runtime for potential kernel/variant issue.
Maria - SRE: ack @Raj P - I'm reading the logs. Example from edge logs:
```
2026-06-12T14:02:12.324Z route=us-west fallback=eu-west model=redwood-xl-v2-quantized status=502 backend=runtime-42 error="kv-cache-mismatch: unsupported-quantize-kernel" request_id=rid_0a1b2c
2026-06-12T14:02:13.128Z route=us-west fallback=eu-west status=502 step=dispatch
```
Maria - SRE: root cause looks like smart-routing policy allowed a fallback variant that isn't compatible with the eu-west runtime build. That config (policy id pr-348) allowed any compatible-arch variant, but we forgot to restrict to runtime-approved quantization profiles.
Kai (infra): confirmed — eu-west nodes are running runtime build 2.1.1 which lacks the optimized quantized kernels we rolled out in 2.2.0. Smart-routing didn't check runtime build before sending variant. Bad combo -> 502s.
Emma L: impact check: which customers hit this? Network traces show a handful of high-traffic customers in APAC hitting us-west then being routed to eu-west — about 8 customers, ~3% of total requests for the last 10m but error rate for them ~45%.
Raj P: immediate mitigation options: 1) disable cross-region fallback globally, 2) restrict fallback variants to 'safe' non-quantized variants, 3) force eu-west runtime upgrade. Which is fastest?
Maria - SRE: upgrade is a bit slow (need staging > canary > rollout). Fastest: temporarily disable cross-region fallback for the affected smart-routing policy and add a policy block for quantized variants. Doing that now.
Maria - SRE: running runbook command:
```
# disable cross-region fallback for policy pr-348
redctl smart-routing update pr-348 --fallback=none --allowed-variants="redwood-xl-v2,redwood-xl-v2-fp16" --note="mitigation 1998765432"
```
Kai (infra): I'm applying a DNS/edge cache flush too — there are stale rrsets that still point to eu-west fallback. Run: `dnsctl purge api.redwood.com --regions eu-west,us-west --force`
IncidentBot: Action log: mitigation started by Maria - SRE at 2026-06-12T14:08:05Z.
Maria - SRE: mitigation executed. Monitoring now. Initial effect: 5xx rate dropping from 12% -> 2.4% within 2 minutes.
Emma L: Uptime pages: customer A (acme-inc) reported 40% failed requests earlier, now back to ~1%. ETA to stable: ~15-20m subject to DNS TTLs.
Raj P: leaving a temporary traffic policy so we don't accidentally re-enable broad fallback. Also creating an ACL to block the incompatible variant: `policyctl deny-variant redwood-xl-v2-quantized --policy pr-348`
Kai (infra): note on propagation: some edge caches hold stale endpoint mappings for ~TTL 120s but some intermediate caches had longer effective TTL; I triggered a purge and requested CDNs to drop. Should fully settle in ~5-10m.
sre_oncall: taking over incident. I'm going to monitor for 30m then coordinate handoff. @Kai please collect the list of affected nodes and builds.
Kai (infra): list attached (abbreviated): eu-west nodes runtime=2.1.1; us-west nodes runtime=2.2.0. Affected node ids: ew-rt-12, ew-rt-15, ew-rt-18.
Maria - SRE: action items so far: (1) mitigation applied (fallback disabled + deny variant), (2) CDN purge executed, (3) customers notified via status page.
Emma L: sent initial customer note on status.redwood.com: "We observed elevated errors for some API requests during a routing fallback. We have applied mitigations and errors are trending down. Engineers are investigating."
Raj P: risk assessment: residual risk that variant mapping logic in smart-routing will attempt fallback later — we should add a runtime/version check to routing decision before selecting a variant. Filing a follow-up JIRA now.
Maria - SRE: creating INC-2026-453 in postmortem queue. Assigning eng-runtime to investigate variant compatibility table and policy validation in compile-time checks.
sre_oncall: monitoring update at +12m: error rate stabilized at 0.5%, latency normal. Marking incident state: mitigated. Starting handoff to next oncall @Kai (infra) for follow-up during working hours.
Kai (infra): acked. I'll coordinate with runtime team to schedule an eu-west canary upgrade to 2.2.0 and add preflight checks to smart-routing.
Emma L: customer impact summary to include in postmortem: "8 customers impacted briefly; peak error rate 45% for some clients during fallback window; estimated customer minutes impacted ~460m total across all customers; no data loss; requests retried where clients did."
Maria - SRE: closure steps: add timeline + logs to INC-2026-453, document runbook adjustments (add runtime build check + variant whitelist per region), schedule a follow-up runbook dry-run.
sre_oncall: closing the page. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
Emma L: leaving comment — recommend a nonblocking alert when fallback target runtime build < caller runtime build. Will add to the alerting backlog.
Raj P: creating a small postmortem doc and linking to the JIRA. Will add owners for remediation tasks.
Kai (infra): logs/artefacts uploaded to shared incident bucket: s3://redwood-incidents/1998765432.
IncidentBot: Incident mitigated. Summary posted to #incidents. Postmortem ticket INC-2026-453 created.
Maria - SRE: follow-up owners: eng-runtime (investigate variant-selection logic), eng-platform (smart-routing policy validation), infra (upgrade eu-west runtime). ETA for fixes: 2 weeks for validation + 1-week planned runtime upgrade window.
sre_oncall: final note: if we see any reoccurrence re-open page. Otherwise I'll write a short blameless summary and mark this thread resolved.
Emma L: thanks all — good coordination.
